annotations.title: Signet — revoke a mandate (kills its session key)

description: Revoke one of YOUR mandates by id. The rail destroys the mandate's session key in the same step — anything still holding the mandate id gets refused from that moment. This is the off switch you name when granting authority. Requires Authorization: Bearer <JWT>.

mandate_id.description: The mandate uuid (from signet_grant or signet_status)
